catalog.name: Advanced Land Surface Analysis
catalog.description: Advanced land surface products from NASA missions providing detailed information about land surface properties, energy balance, and hydrological processes essential for water resource management and climate studies.

info.name: Attribution
info.content: Land surface products from NASA MODIS, AIRS, and GLDAS missions. Processing by NASA Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center (LP DAAC) and Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO). Contact: earthdata-support@nasa.gov

info.name: License
info.content: NASA data is generally available for public use. Land surface products support hydrological modeling, water resource planning, and climate research applications.

info.name: Hydrological Relevance
info.content: Land surface properties directly control evapotranspiration, runoff generation, infiltration rates, and energy partitioning, making these products essential for water resource assessment.

info.name: Water Cycle Applications
info.content: These products enable quantification of land-atmosphere water and energy exchanges, supporting improved hydrological modeling and water balance calculations.

members.name: Land Surface Temperature
members.description: High-resolution land surface temperature products for understanding thermal conditions, energy balance, and water stress indicators.

members.name: MODIS Land Surface Temperature (Terra, Daily)
members.description: Daily daytime land surface temperature from MODIS Terra at 1km resolution, essential for energy balance and water stress assessment.

info.name: Background
info.content: Land Surface Temperature (LST) represents the radiative skin temperature of the land surface, providing critical information about surface energy balance and thermal conditions.

info.name: Measurement Units
info.content: Temperature in Kelvin (K), representing the radiative temperature of the land surface

info.name: Spatial Resolution
info.content: 1 km spatial resolution enabling detailed thermal analysis and urban heat island studies

info.name: Temporal Coverage
info.content: February 2000 to present, daily daytime observations from Terra satellite

info.name: Hydrological Applications
info.content: LST is essential for evapotranspiration estimation, water stress detection, irrigation management, and surface energy balance calculations

info.name: Water Stress Indicator
info.content: High LST often indicates water stress in vegetation, while LST patterns can reveal soil moisture variations and irrigation effects

info.name: Applications
info.content: Evapotranspiration modeling, drought monitoring, irrigation efficiency assessment, urban heat island analysis, surface energy balance studies

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA MODIS mission team, NASA Land Processes DAAC (LP DAAC)

members.name: MODIS Land Surface Temperature (Terra, Night)
members.description: Daily nighttime land surface temperature from MODIS Terra providing thermal minima and cooling rates important for water cycle processes.

info.name: Background
info.content: Nighttime LST represents minimum daily thermal conditions and provides information about surface cooling rates and thermal inertia properties.

info.name: Thermal Inertia
info.content: Nighttime LST patterns reflect soil moisture content, surface roughness, and thermal properties important for understanding water availability

info.name: Cooling Rate Analysis
info.content: Day-night LST differences indicate surface energy balance characteristics and evaporative cooling effects

info.name: Applications
info.content: Surface energy balance analysis, soil thermal property assessment, evaporative cooling evaluation, thermal inertia mapping

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA MODIS mission team, NASA Land Processes DAAC (LP DAAC)

members.name: AIRS Land Surface Temperature (Daily)
members.description: Daily land surface temperature from AIRS infrared sounder with all-weather capability and high radiometric accuracy.

info.name: Background
info.content: AIRS (Atmospheric Infrared Sounder) provides LST measurements using thermal infrared channels with high radiometric accuracy and some all-weather capability.

info.name: All-Weather Capability
info.content: AIRS can retrieve LST through thin clouds, providing more complete temporal coverage than visible/IR imaging instruments

info.name: High Accuracy
info.content: AIRS LST products have high radiometric accuracy, making them suitable for climate monitoring and long-term trend analysis

info.name: Spatial Resolution
info.content: 50 km spatial resolution suitable for regional to global scale thermal analysis and climate studies

info.name: Applications
info.content: Climate monitoring, thermal trend analysis, regional energy balance studies, all-weather surface temperature monitoring

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA AIRS mission team, NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL)

members.name: Evapotranspiration & Energy Fluxes
members.description: Evapotranspiration and surface energy flux products quantifying land-atmosphere water and energy exchanges.

members.name: MODIS Evapotranspiration (8-Day)
members.description: 8-day evapotranspiration from MODIS providing quantitative estimates of water loss from land surface to atmosphere.

info.name: Background
info.content: Evapotranspiration (ET) represents the combined water loss through evaporation from soil and water surfaces and transpiration from vegetation, a key component of the water cycle.

info.name: Measurement Units
info.content: Evapotranspiration in millimeters per 8-day period (mm/8day), representing water depth equivalent

info.name: Algorithm Basis
info.content: Uses Penman-Monteith equation with MODIS land surface temperature, vegetation indices, and meteorological inputs to estimate ET

info.name: Water Balance Component
info.content: ET is crucial for water balance calculations, representing the largest water loss term in most terrestrial water budgets

info.name: Spatial Resolution
info.content: 500m spatial resolution enabling field-scale to regional evapotranspiration assessment

info.name: Hydrological Applications
info.content: Essential for water resource assessment, irrigation scheduling, drought monitoring, and hydrological model calibration

info.name: Applications
info.content: Water resource management, irrigation efficiency assessment, drought impact evaluation, hydrological modeling, water balance studies

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA MODIS mission team, evapotranspiration algorithm development teams

members.name: GLDAS Underground Soil Moisture (Monthly)
members.description: Monthly underground soil moisture from GLDAS land surface model representing subsurface water content in soil layers.

info.name: Background
info.content: Underground soil moisture represents water content in subsurface soil layers, critical for understanding subsurface water storage and root zone water availability.

info.name: Measurement Units
info.content: Soil moisture content in volumetric fraction (m³/m³) or equivalent water thickness

info.name: Subsurface Water Storage
info.content: Underground soil moisture indicates subsurface water storage capacity and availability for vegetation and groundwater recharge

info.name: Model Integration
info.content: GLDAS integrates satellite observations with land surface models to provide comprehensive surface energy flux estimates

info.name: Spatial Resolution
info.content: 0.25° spatial resolution suitable for regional water and energy balance studies

info.name: Applications
info.content: Hydrological modeling, drought monitoring, agricultural water management, groundwater recharge assessment, soil water storage analysis

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA Global Land Data Assimilation System (GLDAS), NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO)

members.name: GLDAS Surface Total Precipitation Rate (Monthly)
members.description: Monthly surface total precipitation rate from GLDAS representing combined rainfall and snowfall reaching the land surface.

info.name: Background
info.content: Surface total precipitation rate represents the combined water input from rainfall and snowfall reaching the land surface, fundamental for hydrological cycle analysis.

info.name: Precipitation Components
info.content: Total precipitation includes both liquid (rain) and solid (snow) forms, providing comprehensive water input assessment

info.name: Hydrological Significance
info.content: Precipitation rate is the primary water input driving hydrological processes, soil moisture replenishment, and river discharge

info.name: Applications
info.content: Hydrological modeling, flood forecasting, drought monitoring, water resource management, agricultural planning

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA Global Land Data Assimilation System (GLDAS), NASA GMAO

members.name: Surface Albedo & Radiation
members.description: Surface albedo and radiation budget products essential for understanding energy balance and land surface-atmosphere interactions.

members.name: MODIS Surface Albedo (16-Day)
members.description: 16-day surface albedo from MODIS Terra indicating land surface reflectance properties and energy balance characteristics.

info.name: Background
info.content: Surface albedo represents the fraction of solar radiation reflected by land surface, controlling the amount of solar energy absorbed and available for heating and evapotranspiration.

info.name: Energy Balance Role
info.content: Albedo directly controls surface energy absorption, affecting temperature, evapotranspiration, and local climate conditions

info.name: Measurement Units
info.content: Dimensionless reflectance fraction (0-1), where 0 represents complete absorption and 1 represents complete reflection

info.name: Surface Properties
info.content: Albedo varies with surface type, vegetation cover, soil moisture, snow cover, and land use, providing insights into surface conditions

info.name: Spatial Resolution
info.content: 500m spatial resolution enabling detailed surface property analysis

info.name: Hydrological Relevance
info.content: Albedo changes affect energy available for evapotranspiration and influence local water cycle processes

info.name: Applications
info.content: Surface energy balance modeling, land use change detection, vegetation monitoring, climate impact assessment

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA MODIS mission team, albedo algorithm development teams

members.name: CERES Surface Radiation Budget (Monthly)
members.description: Monthly surface radiation budget from CERES providing comprehensive energy balance information for hydrological applications.

info.name: Background
info.content: CERES (Clouds and the Earth's Radiant Energy System) provides comprehensive surface radiation budget measurements essential for understanding energy available for hydrological processes.

info.name: Radiation Components
info.content: Includes downward and upward shortwave and longwave radiation components, providing complete surface energy budget information

info.name: Net Radiation Calculation
info.content: Net radiation represents total energy available at surface for heating, evapotranspiration, and other physical processes

info.name: Hydrological Applications
info.content: Net radiation is fundamental for evapotranspiration calculations and surface energy balance modeling in hydrological studies

info.name: Spatial Resolution
info.content: 1° spatial resolution suitable for regional to global scale energy balance studies

info.name: Applications
info.content: Evapotranspiration modeling, surface energy balance analysis, hydrological model forcing, climate model validation

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA CERES mission team, surface radiation budget algorithm teams
